page.overview:
What is Ice Path?

Ice Path is a location introduced in Generation II.

It is an ice-filled cave that connects Route 44 and Blackthorn City. It is home to several -type Pokémon such as Jynx and Swinub. The player has to defeat Pryce in a Pokémon battle before they can access the Ice Path.

Strength is needed to push boulders down holes in order to navigate through Ice Path. However, boulders cannot be moved again once they are sunk into the holes.

The Ice Path has several items such as Never-Melt Ice and even the HM Waterfall.
